title: On the square of an isosimple module
summary: Let $S$ be an isosimple module, that is, a nonzero module isomorphic to every nonzero submodule of itself. In this paper, we investigate if the square $S^2 := S \oplus S$ is isoantian when $S$ is an isosimple module. If the base ring is commutative, then the answer is yes. However, for noncommutative rings this is no longer true even when $\mathrm{End}_R(S)$ is a discrete valuation ring. We also give some positive results coming from quasi-projectivity and Morita equivalence. Finally, we consider when every finite powers of an isosimple module are isoantian provided it holds for the square.…
